name: What kind of shower designs are possible for a conversion?

mainEntity.name: What kind of shower designs are possible for a conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathtub-to-shower conversions offer a wide range of design possibilities. You can choose from simple, functional designs with pre-fabricated units to luxurious, custom-tiled walk-in showers with built-in benches, niches for toiletries, and multiple showerheads. Options include barrier-free showers for seamless entry, curbed showers, and various enclosure styles like frameless glass, semi-frameless, or framed. Material choices range from classic ceramic and porcelain tiles to natural stone, acrylic, and solid surface panels, allowing for extensive personalization to match your bathroom's aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design options range from simple pre-fabricated units to custom-tiled walk-in showers with benches and niches. Choices include barrier-free or curbed showers, various glass enclosures, and diverse material selections.
